item.title: DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813 Released: 1M Context, Official Price Hike Warning
item.description: DeepSeek released deepseek-v4-pro (0813) on 2026-08-13: 1M context, 384K max output, $0.435/M input and $0.87/M output, with cache-hit input at just $0.003625/M. The official docs also warn that overall API pricing will rise significantly in the near future. Includes Claude Code / Codex setup and community benchmark roundup.
